goal: Search one-way flights from Zurich to London on Tuesday, December 15, 2026.
verify: (() => { if (!location.href.includes('/travel/flights/search')) return false; const val = name => [...document.querySelectorAll('input')]   .filter(e => e.offsetParent !== null && (e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim() === name)   .map(e => e.value)[0] || ''; const retVisible = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-label="Return"]')]   .some(e => e.offsetParent !== null); return val('Where from?').includes('Zürich')   && val('Where to?').includes('London')   && val('Departure').includes('Dec 15')   && !retVisible;})()
